name: ZCA_FEED_DAYZERO_CONFIGS
description: Table to store day zero attribute configurations

columns.name: FEED_DAYZERO_CONFIG_ATTR_ID
columns.description: ID Column : Auto generated primary key of the table

columns.name: FEED_TYPE
columns.description: Feed object type eg: Lead

columns.name: EVENT_OBJ_NAME
columns.description: Related object name of the parent object Eg Note

columns.name: PARENT_OBJ_NAME
columns.description: Parent object name of the feed type Eg Appointment

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_DATA_TYPE
columns.description: Data type of the day zero filter attribute

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_NAME
columns.description: Day zero filter attribute name Eg : Status

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_DEF_VALUE
columns.description: Default day zero filter attribute value Eg: Won

columns.name: OPERATOR
columns.description: Operator for the day zero attributes eg: IN

columns.name: ENABLE_FOR_DAYZERO_FLAG
columns.description: Flag for the filter attribute to be considered for the day zero filter criteria

columns.name: MANDATORY_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to make day zero filter attribute as mandatory

columns.name: VISIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to make day zero filter attribute to be visible in UI

columns.name: READ_ONLY_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to make day zero filter attribute as non editable

columns.name: SEQUENCE
columns.description: Order of the filter conditions

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description for the attribute

columns.name: DAYZERO_CONDITION
columns.description: Dayzero criteria filter condition . Default value AND

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
